name: What features should I look for when comparing AEO software vendors?

mainEntity.name: What features should I look for when comparing AEO software vendors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top AEO software features include AI visibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews simultaneously, zero-click performance tracking (mention frequency, citation context), and snippet analysis to identify which content blocks AI extracts most. Competitive analysis reports showing AI market share changes and sentiment tracking are also critical.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for multi-platform AI monitoring (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI), zero-click metrics (mentions, citations), snippet analysis, competitive AI market share reports, and sentiment tracking.
